```{python}
obj_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object'])

summary_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Data Type': obj_cols.dtypes,
    'Unique Values': obj_cols.nunique(),
    'Missing Values': obj_cols.isna().sum()
})

print(summary_df)
```
